Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS). **A whole new look.**

### New

- **A new look for the lyrics.** They now start in the **Arc** layout: only the line being sung, on a gentle curve, in bold periwinkle letters with a solid 3D edge. Words come in as they are sung, in little groups that each lean and size a bit differently, and the next word waits faintly before it's sung. Each line appears where you're looking and stays there until the whole line drifts away. Pick the layout under **Lyrics → Layout**:
  - **Arc**: one line on a gentle curve.
  - **Lines**: the previous, current and next lines, straight and centred, like before.
  - **World**: each word or two appears in the world around you as it's sung, in big bold capitals, and fades as newer ones arrive.
- **Bold letters and Depth.** **Look → Font** now has four choices: Bold (the new default), Smooth, Handwritten and Minecraft. **Look → Depth** gives the letters a solid edge so they look raised. The glow now starts at zero; turn **Look → Glow** up if you liked it.
- **A new top bar.** A rounded bar that grows and shrinks with each line, with the cover, the words lighting up as they're sung and a highlight that glides along. The clock sits on its left and your frames per second and ping on its right; turn either off under **Display → Top bar** (**Clock** and **Stats**). It also moves below boss bars instead of covering them.
- **Two new night skies**: **Synthwave**, a purple sky with a big striped retro sun low down, and **Eclipse**, a black sun with a glowing ring and flare under a faint milky way. Pick them under **Look → Night sky**. **Constellations** joins some of the stars with thin lines.
- New soft colours to pick from: periwinkle, pink, lavender, sky blue and cream.
- Liked the old look? Set **Lyrics → Layout** to Lines, **Look → Font** to Smooth, turn **Depth** off, turn **Glow** up and set **Colour** to Album.

### Better

- The settings screen reads correctly in Hebrew, and its arrows point the right way.

Install: drop the jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API (see the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install)).
